transcript: The timer was loud. My reason was missing. Ten seconds left, and suddenly I wanted something I hadn't wanted a minute ago. My hand moved. Then I stopped. Was I choosing the thing... or escaping the countdown? I let the numbers keep falling. The clock could finish its countdown. I still needed a reason.
